title: Roommate Rent Transfer
scenario: A new roommate says the landlord changed accounts and rent must go to them today.

answers.A: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.B: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Roommate Rent Transfer: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Verify payment changes directly with the landlord using known contact details.
